name: x2611_11972_euler
statement:
noncomputable def x2611_11972_euler (k : List ℤ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑' n : Fin k.length → ℕ, if StrictMono n then
    ∏ j : Fin k.length,
      (if k.get j < 0 then (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n j + 1) else 1) /
        ((n j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k.get j).natAbs
    else 0
